newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel started as a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel started as a hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it initiated coverage of Brazilian power utility Copel with a hold rating.
-- It said the company is well-positioned to prosper in a deregulated environment, "but has less room for efficiency gains than other Brazilian electrics."

-- "Our analysis suggests that Copel may be somewhat undervalued on both a cash flow and asset basis. But in the absence of any move toward privatization, we see little chance that Copel will outperform other shares in the Brazilian electricity sector," it said.
-- Copel serves a market of 2.5 million customers in southern state of Parana, it added.
-- Copel preferred shares traded at 11.05 reais, down 0.36 percent, at 1300 local/1500 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
